response.original_title: Official Update : How do I add a passenger on MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add another Passenger to an existing MSC Cruise reservation 1 (866) 829-1280, you must call MSC Cruise Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1 (866) 829-1280, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a Passenger to a MSC Cruise online 1 (866) 829-1280, so you must contact MSC Cruise customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1 (866) 829-1280. To add a guest to an existing MSC Cruise booking 1 (866) 829-1280, you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
